source.notes: arch-007 (A2 indexed-K1). DSA (DeepSeek Sparse Attention): lightning indexer scores every causal key I[t,s] = Σ_j w_idx[t,j]·act(scale·q_idx[t,j]·k_idx[s]) (MQA shared index key), top-k causal keys per query (-1 padded, selection shared across query heads), then softmax(scale·q·k)·v over the gathered selected tokens only. The indexer route is external; the mixer is the shared typed indexed-K1 call. Verified against fla/ops/dsa/naive.py @ 864a87f6. Layer module: architectures/dsa.py.
